title: sk-vision README version carrier stale at 0.3.5.0

README trust-skip comment overstates skipped gates

detail: commit range dd001838f0/54a2e9abbc/424f28b8fc verified against its claims: engine lines, build step, trust key and runtime spellings match; checker exit 3 and hook handling reproduced before/after; suites 97/0 (hook), 7/7 (checker), 2/2 (pi), 7/7 (hook-registration); sync --check PASS for Hermes (68) and hook registrations (4)

reason: checker previously used only 0/1; no other consumer; both hooks handle 3 explicitly; CI fail-closed on 3 is intended

direction: shell rc capture broken under set -euo pipefail
reason: || MIRROR_RC=$? capture is correct and exercised by the full harness (97/0 at HEAD; 96/1 with the base hook)
static repo-relative paths only; minimal sentinel + lazy loader; no new deps, options or layers
